newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia's olive oil output 250,000 tonnes - minister.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia's olive oil output 250,000 tonnes - minister.

text.p: Tunisia's olive oil output for this season was put at 250,000 tonnes some two to three weeks from the end of the season, the Agriculture Minister said on Thursday.

Tunisia, the world's largest exporter of olive oil, has so far exported 12,550 tonnes in 1996/97, including 11,000 tonnes by 18 private exporters and 1,550 by the state-controlled Office National de l'Huile, ONH, Mabrouk Bahri said.
He said that ONH has so far collected 127,000 tonnes of olive oil and private exporters had 15,000 tonnes.
"The quality of olive oil this year is excellent with an average acidity rate of one percent," Bahri said.

Last season saw output of only 60,000 tonnes because of a drought in the previous two years. The last output record was achieved in the 1991/1992 season with 280,000 tonnes. --Tunis newsroom, 2161-787538
